_comment: One recording, two classes named inline and no header identifying either. Since #99 a recording is about exactly one class: the model returns an empty class_name rather than guessing, and AssembleNotes attaches every span to nobody. So the pass condition is zero notes — a wrong class puts one child's observations in another child's note, which is what #99 exists to stop. must_not_extract carries every content phrase: whichever class the model wrongly picked, the leak shows up here. The unattributed spans still hold the right text for #80 to assign by hand. Roster names were full names until #108 switched them to first names, the shape the teacher speaks — see task #111.
